_about: Exceptions for scripts/rules-drift-check.mjs. Every entry needs a one-line reason. Adding an entry is an owner-visible decision; do not add one just to turn the check green. Layout since 2026-10-24: rules are real in .ai/rules with links in .cursor/rules and .claude/rules; skills are real in .agents/skills with links in .cursor/skills and .claude/skills.

cursorOnlyRules.no-claude-in-cursor: About Cursor agents not calling Claude; Claude Code has nothing to obey, so it gets no .claude/rules link.
cursorOnlyRules.grok-lattice-overseer-perpetual: Glob rule for the Grok overseer in Cursor, so it gets no .claude/rules link.
cursorOnlyRules.ui-standards: Glob rule that only points Cursor at docs/rules/UI-STANDARDS.md; Claude reads that doc through CLAUDE.md, so it gets no .claude/rules link.

codexOnlySkills.source-command-flywheel: Codex's migrated copy of .claude/commands/flywheel.md (same text). It is left as is and gets no .cursor or .claude link.
